connector.name: Chainweb API
connector.registryDescription: Chainweb HTTP API: local sim, pre-signed send, poll, table reads, SPV proofs, module deploys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-chainweb. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pact-community-organization account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: PACT_COMMUNITY_WORKSPACE_ROOT
env.description: Workspace root directory; all file access is confined inside it.

env.name: PACT_COMMUNITY_CHAINWEB_MODE
env.description: Network mode; must be set and match PACT_COMMUNITY_CHAINWEB_PROFILE (devnet, testnet06, or mainnet).

env.name: PACT_COMMUNITY_CHAINWEB_PROFILE
env.description: Network profile: devnet (default, read/write), testnet06, or mainnet (both read-only).

env.name: PACT_COMMUNITY_CHAINWEB_BASE_URL
env.description: Chainweb node base URL (default per profile).

env.name: PACT_COMMUNITY_CHAINWEB_NETWORK_ID
env.description: Network id, e.g. development, testnet06, mainnet01 (default per profile).
